title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We're looking for a DevOps / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure.

This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments.

We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.



Why this role exists

We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing DevOps operations and architecture support.

We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well.

Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.



TL;DR

You will help lead cloud and DevOps initiatives at Quave. Your job is to:

  • Lead cloud migrations to OCI
  • Design cloud architectures
  • Automate migrations and infrastructure
  • Coordinate DevOps engineers
  • Talk directly to clients
  • Help build repeatable DevOps processes

You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.

English is a plus, not required.



This is not a ticket-based DevOps job

If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.

This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:


\"We can automate 80% of this.\"

And then actually build the automation.



What you'll actually do

Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.



Cloud Migrations

A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.

Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.



Automation

We want to automate everything that can be automated:

  • Automated infrastructure provisioning
  • Migration scripts
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Environment replication
  • Monitoring setups

If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.



Client Discussions

You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.



Leading DevOps Engineers

As the DevOps work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.



What we're looking for

You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.

You likely:

  • Love automating infrastructure
  • Hate manual processes
  • Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
  • Are comfortable debugging production environments
  • Enjoy designing architectures
  • Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients

You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.



Technical Expectations

Cloud

  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important
  • AWS
  • Azure
  • GCP

    • DevOps

    • Docker
    • Kubernetes
    • Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
    • CI/CD pipelines
    • Linux systems administration
    • Networking fundamentals

    Automation

    Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.


    Languages

    Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.


    Why work with Quave

    We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software.

    Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy.

    Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).


    Pay and Benefits

    This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience.

    • Fully remote work
    • Flexible hours
    • 22 days paid time off per year
    • Quarterly bonus based on company performance
    • AI allowance for productivity tools

    We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.


    Hiring Process

    • Application review
    • Technical conversation
    • Architecture discussion
    • Conversation(s) with one or more partners
    • This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the DevOps work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

title: Ecommerce Growth Marketing Paid Media Specialist
description:

Responsibilities

title: Product Specialist
description:
About the Role:

CloudSEK is seeking a motivated and versatile Cybersecurity Operations Analyst to join our expanding global team. This is a multifaceted role that blends Product Support , Cyber Threat Takedown Operations , and Security Event Analysis . You will be the first line of defense in securing our customers and upholding the integrity of their digital presence.

This position is ideal for candidates who are early to mid in their cybersecurity career with 1-2 years of exp and are passionate about threat detection, user support, and protecting brands from malicious online activity.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Technical Product Support (CloudSEK Product) – L1

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customer issues via email, chat, or phone.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve basic technical issues using documentation and internal tools.
  • Record and track support issues in our ticketing system with clarity and precision.
  • Collaborate with engineering and security teams to escalate unresolved issues.
  • Contribute to user guides and help documentation for common support queries.
  • Continuously learn and apply knowledge of cybersecurity and threat detection.


2. Brand Protection & Takedown Analyst

  • Monitor, identify, and document phishing websites, fake domains, and impersonation profiles on social media platforms.
  • Initiate and manage takedown requests across hosting providers, registrars, and platforms.
  • Provide timely follow-ups and status updates to internal teams and stakeholders.
  • Assist in building and maintaining playbooks, SOPs, and threat feeds relevant to brand abuse.
  • Work closely with the intelligence team to map phishing campaigns and related threat infrastructure.


3. L1 Security Analyst (SOC/Threat Monitoring)

  • As a member of the comanaged services team, monitor alerts and incidents generated on the CloudSEK portal.
  • Conduct initial triage and classification of potential threats.
  • Document response steps and escalate incidents as per defined protocols.
  • Stay updated with the latest cyber threats, TTPs, and security advisories.
  • Apply AI prompt engineering techniques to improve efficiency in threat detection and knowledge handling.


Desired Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or related fields.
  • Prior exposure or a strong interest in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or SOC operations.
  • Understanding of phishing campaigns, social engineering tactics, and brand impersonation threats.
  • Strong communication skills (written & verbal).
  • Ability to work independently in a rotational shift environment supporting global customers.
  • Experience with support ticketing tools (e.g., Freshdesk, Zendesk, Jira Service Desk).
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and platforms (e.g., VirusTotal, Whois, SIEM, OSINT tools).
  • Basic knowledge of cloud security, APIs, or red teaming (bonus, not required).
  • Proficiency with scripting (Python, Bash) or automation is a plus.
  • Certifications like CEH, Security+, or practical experience in phishing mitigation will be advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Language proficiency: Ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing along with Portuguese and Spanish


Working Conditions:

  • Location: Brazil
  • Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid (based on location & team structure).
  • Working hours: Rotational shifts to support coverage for US and LATAM customers.(EST and PST).


Why Join Us?

  • Work at the intersection of cybersecurity , AI , and digital risk protection .
  • Exposure to real-world cyber threats, takedown operations, and incident response.
  • Learn from seasoned cybersecurity professionals in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Opportunity to grow your career in Cyber Security with practical application

title: Product Owner - Sênior
description:
Product Owner - Sênior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

No seu dia a dia, você gerenciará o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias. Atuará como principal interlocutor entre as áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório, supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis. Além disso, acompanhará métricas de desempenho do produto (KPIs de negócio e de uso), proporá evoluções baseadas em dados e feedback dos usuários, e garantirá que as soluções desenvolvidas estejam em conformidade com as normas de segurança e regulação do setor de gás.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Gerenciar o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias.
  • Atuar como principal interlocutor(a) entre áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório e supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis.
  • Liderar cerimônias ágeis e garantir a entrega contínua de valor para o produto.
  • Promover melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás.
  • Acompanhar métricas de desempenho (KPIs de negócio e de uso), analisando dados para direcionar evoluções do produto.
  • Propor melhorias com base em dados e feedbacks dos usuários.
  • Garantir que as soluções estejam em conformidade com normas de segurança e regulação do setor.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Visão holística e estratégica, com capacidade de compreender o negócio de distribuição de gás de ponta a ponta, conectando iniciativas de tecnologia às metas do negócio.
  • Perfil de liderança com forte viés de execução, sendo “mão na massa”, orientado(a) a resultados e capaz de remover impedimentos para garantir entregas com qualidade e agilidade.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de transitar entre áreas, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia.
  • Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e práticas de gestão de produto (roadmaps, OKRs, MVPs).
  • Experiência na liderança de squads multidisciplinares e atuação em ciclos de discovery e delivery.
  • Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Negócios, Energia ou Transformação Digital.
  • Tiver certificações em Product Ownership (CSPO, PSPO) e metodologias ágeis (CSM, SAFe).
  • Tiver familiaridade com o setor de gás e energia, incluindo regulação da ANP e processos como medição, faturamento, logística e segurança operacional.
  • Demonstrar forte visão sistêmica e pensamento crítico.
  • Apresentar habilidade de negociação e influência.
  • Ser resiliente e adaptável em ambientes de alta complexidade.
  • Ter perfil colaborativo e facilitador.
  • Demonstrar orientação a resultados e senso de urgência.
  • Possuir experiência em contextos dinâmicos.

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

Will be responsible to perform research to find high-value accounts to target as well as spend time developing growth strategies from their findings. They will ensure marketing activities line up with strategies developed and ultimately translate plans to the sales team for execution. They need to ensure the follow steps are covered:

  • Identify high-value target accounts – Identify key accounts that have the potential to contribute the most to the revenue of your company.

  • Webinars
  • SEO – Quarterly updates on the regional assigned webpage
  • Social media – Weekly updates on social media platforms in where they are based – language will depend on where they are based

Will handle the planning and implementation of offline marketing tasks in the assigned region which could cover

  • Master’s degree in a Marketing related discipline.
  • Around 10 years of experience

Skills Needed


Market Research and Analysis: The ability to conduct thorough market research, analyze data, and draw actionable insights is crucial for understanding the target market, consumer behavior, and industry trends.

Strategic Planning: Regional Marketing Managers must be adept at developing and executing marketing strategies that align with overall business objectives. This includes setting clear goals, defining KPIs, and creating actionable plans.

Team Leadership and Management: Effective leadership skills are important for managing and motivating a team of marketing professionals. This includes providing guidance, setting expectations, and facilitating collaboration.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Regional Marketing Managers need to work closely with various departments like sales, product development, and supply chain to ensure that marketing initiatives are aligned with overall business operations.

Brand Management: They should have the ability to maintain and enhance the brand image in the specified region. This involves ensuring consistency in messaging, visual identity, and customer experience.

Campaign Management: This skill involves planning, executing, and optimizing marketing campaigns. It requires the ability to set clear objectives, target the right audience, and measure the effectiveness of campaigns.

Budget Management: Effective allocation and management of marketing budgets are essential for maximizing return on investment (ROI) and ensuring that resources are used efficiently.

Data Analysis and Interpretation: Proficiency in using data analytics tools to measure campaign performance, track key metrics, and derive actionable insights is crucial for making informed marketing decisions.

Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills are necessary for conveying marketing messages effectively to various stakeholders, including team members, executives, and external partners.

Adaptability and Flexibility: The ability to adapt to changing market conditions, consumer preferences, and industry trends is vital for staying competitive and achieving long-term success.

Problem-Solving Skills: Regional Marketing Managers should be able to identify challenges and develop creative solutions to overcome them. This includes being resourceful and thinking critically.

Cultural Awareness and Sensitivity: Especially in a regional role, understanding and respecting cultural nuances and preferences is important for tailoring marketing strategies to specific markets.

Time Management: Effectively prioritizing tasks and managing time to meet deadlines is essential in a fast-paced marketing environment.

Tech-Savviness: Familiarity with marketing technology tools and platforms, as well as proficiency in relevant software and applications, is important for executing marketing initiatives efficiently.

Negotiation Skills: The ability to negotiate and build partnerships with external stakeholders, such as agencies, vendors, and media outlets, can be crucial for successful marketing campaigns.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
This is mostly manual position. This role is fully remote and is a PJ contractor.


Required Skills & Experience


• 7+ years of experience in Quality Assurance (manual and/or blended QA roles) with strong ownership of test execution and release readiness.

• Jira proficiency for defect tracking, workflows, and reporting.

• Hands-on experience with API testing (e.g., Postman, Swagger, curl, or similar) — note: API work is a smaller portion (~10%).

• Cruise / travel / hotel / hospitality industry experience

• Strong understanding of QA fundamentals: test design, defect lifecycle, SDLC/STLC, and Agile testing practices. Excellent communication skills and ability to partner cross-functionally.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• Experience testing eCommerce, booking engines, reservations, loyalty, payments, check-in/boarding, or guest service platforms.

• Exposure to test automation (any framework/tool) and ability to collaborate with automation engineers (if applicable).

• Basic SQL for validation, data checks, or troubleshooting. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and release processes.


Job Description


We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of customer-facing and internal applications in a fast-paced travel/hospitality environment. This role will partner closely with product, engineering, and delivery teams to define test strategy, execute testing across releases, and continuously improve QA processes. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on QA experience, deep familiarity with Jira, and working knowledge of API testing (a smaller portion of the overall workload).


Day to Day

• Own and execute end-to-end testing for web and/or mobile applications, including functional, regression, smoke, and UAT support.

• Create and maintain clear test plans, test cases, and test execution evidence aligned to release timelines.

• Work in Agile/Scrum teams to provide early QA input on requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases.

• Log, track, and manage defects in Jira, ensuring high-quality documentation and strong follow-through through resolution.

• Perform API validation/testing (estimated ~10% of overall effort) using tools such as Postman/Swagger or similar; validate request/response payloads and integration behaviors.

• Collaborate with engineers and product owners to reproduce issues, validate fixes, and confirm release readiness.

• Help improve QA efficiency through better test coverage, risk-based testing, and repeatable regression approaches. Contribute to quality standards, best practices, and continuous improvement across the SDLC.

title: Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
  • Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
  • Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
  • Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
  • Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
  • Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
  • Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
  • Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
  • Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
  • Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
  • Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
  • Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
  • Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
  • Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
  • Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
  • Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
  • Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento).
  • Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança).
  • Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados).
  • Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions).
  • Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas).
  • Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos).
  • Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards).
  • Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio).

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: SAP S/4 HANA BRIM Application Expert (Experto en aplicaciones SAP S/4 HANA BRIM)

  • Hands-on experience in configuring BRIM components and managing end-to-end billing cycles.
  • Understanding on SAP Best Practices in BRIM and SD modules and their integrations & technology.

Desirable:

WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS

  • Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
  • Health and Safety accountability statements.
  • Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis.

Responsabilidades e atribuições



Gerente de Planejamento Comercial e Merchan - SPRINT

Localização: Rio de Janeiro, RJ


I. Missão e Objetivo do Cargo

O Gerente de Planejamento Comercial e Merchan SPRINT é o guardião da viabilidade financeira e da otimização do produto. Sua missão é estruturar as operações de planejamento comercial, desde o zero, garantindo que a Visão de Produto Athleisure seja entregue com a máxima rentabilidade e eficiência de estoque no contexto de lançamento e crescimento rápido.


II. Principais Papéis e Responsabilidades

Este profissional irá capitanear o ciclo de vida do produto do ponto de vista financeiro e logístico.


1. Estrutura e Viabilidade de Compras (Sourcing & OTB)

  • Construção e Gestão do OTB (Open-to-Buy): Desenvolver, gerenciar e defender o orçamento de compras por coleção, categoria e canal, alinhado às metas financeiras agressivas da fase de lançamento.
  • Interface Estratégica com Sourcing: Trabalhar em estreita parceria com o Gerente de Produto (Estilo) e Sourcing para garantir que os tecidos técnicos e as inovações em performance sejam adquiridos com o melhor custo-benefício e prazo.
  • Projeção de Demanda: Garantir a acuracidade do forecast de vendas, considerando a performance histórica (como linha da Reserva) e a projeção para a marca SPRINT independente.


2. Planejamento de Produto e Coleção (Go-to-Market)

  • Definição de Sortimento Estratégico: Liderar a arquitetura da coleção (Mix de Produtos), definindo a pirâmide, o peso das categorias e a profundidade versus amplitude, com foco na assertividade do mix.
  • Análise de Performance Pós-Lançamento: Supervisionar a análise de dados para gerar insights acionáveis que otimizem as coleções em andamento e futuras.
  • Interface Multidisciplinar: Ser o principal ponto de contato entre Produto/Estilo, Logística e Comercial, assegurando o alinhamento de prazos e metas.


3. Gestão de Estoque e Ciclo de Vida (Merchandising)

  • Otimização de Estoque e Giro: Monitorar a cobertura, o giro e o sell-through, garantindo a máxima rentabilidade e minimizando o risco de dead stock.
  • Estratégia de Liquidação (Markdowns): Estruturar o plano tático de remarcações e ações promocionais, visando otimizar estoque com o menor impacto possível na margem bruta, essencial no início da marca.
  • Abastecimento Omnichannel: Definir a estratégia de distribuição inicial e o plano de reposição eficiente para canais digitais e futuras lojas e franquias.


4. Liderança e Desenvolvimento de Equipe

  • Construção de Equipe: Participar ativamente na contratação e no desenvolvimento inicial da equipe de Planejamento, Merchandising e Sourcing.
  • Gestão de Performance e KPIs: Ser o guardião dos indicadores de planejamento (Giro, Cobertura, Margem) e definir metas claras, promovendo o crescimento do time.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Sólida trajetória em Planejamento Comercial, Merchandising ou Produto no Varejo de Moda (mandatório).
  • Experiência no segmento Sports/Athleisure será considerada um diferencial competitivo.
  • Expertise em OTB (Open-to-Buy): Domínio completo na construção, controle e gestão do orçamento de compras.
  • Gestão de KPIs e Ciclo de Vida: Visão analítica apurada sobre Giro, Cobertura, Sell-Through e GMROI. Capacidade de desenhar estratégias para todas as fases do produto, do lançamento à liquidação.
  • Excel Avançado: Capacidade de criar modelagens complexas e transformar grandes volumes de dados em modelos de decisão ágeis.
  • Gestão de Pessoas: Experiência comprovada na coordenação ou gerência de equipes, com foco em formação de times do zero e desenvolvimento de talentos.
  • Perfil estruturado e focado em construir processos escaláveis, com autonomia para atuar em um ambiente de ritmo acelerado (Sprint).
  • Liderança e Influência: Habilidade para transitar entre áreas parceiras (Produto e Comercial), inspirando o time e negociando prioridades em um cenário multidisciplinar.
  • Equilíbrio entre Criatividade e Finanças: Capacidade de garantir a viabilidade financeira (margem e custo) sem engessar a proposta estética e inovadora do Athleisure.
  • Comunicação Estratégica: Facilidade em traduzir métricas complexas em planos de ação claros e insights executivos para a diretoria.


Diferenciais (O que te destaca)

  • Visão Omnichannel: Experiência prática integrando o planejamento entre E-commerce e Varejo Físico.

title: Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP Databases
description:
Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP Databases


Location: Ukraine, Armenia, Moldova, Brazil(Remote)


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Data Engineer to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


About the Role


We're hiring a Senior DBA to own the database layer across our production systems — OLTP relational databases as the operational store and an OLAP columnar database for analytics. Data flows between them via a CDC pipeline (Debezium → Kafka) managed by our infrastructure team. You'll own what's on both ends: schema design, data modeling, query performance, and analytics enablement.

This is a high-ownership role. You'll be the technical authority on how our data is structured, how it performs, and how schema changes propagate safely from OLTP to OLAP stores. You'll work closely with application teams, data consumers, and the infrastructure team that operates the CDC pipeline.


What You'll Own

  • OLTP schema design: Data modeling, indexing strategies, migration planning, and performance tuning across multiple database clusters
  • OLAP data modeling: Table design, materialized views, partitioning, and query optimization for analytics workloads
  • Schema evolution: Coordinating schema changes with the infrastructure team to ensure safe propagation through the CDC pipeline
  • Query performance: Profiling, optimization, and capacity planning across both OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Data integrity: Validation, reconciliation, and monitoring to ensure consistency between OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Technical leadership: Standards for schema management, review processes, mentoring, and cross-team collaboration


Tech Stack

  • OLTP: Aurora MySQL 8.0 (multiple clusters, multi-AZ)
  • OLAP: ClickHouse 25.x
  • CDC Pipeline: Debezium 3.3.2 → Kafka 4.0 → ClickHouse
  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
  • Cloud: AWS (EKS, RDS, S3)


Requirements

  • 5+ years as a DBA or data engineer, 2+ in a senior/lead role
  • Strong experience with OLTP relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or similar) — schema design, indexing, query optimization, replication, migrations
  • Strong experience with OLAP/columnar databases (ClickHouse, Vertica, Greenplum, Druid, Doris, or similar) — table design, materialized views, partitioning, query optimization Deep SQL expertise across both transactional and analytical query patterns
  • Experience with schema migration strategies in environments with downstream consumers (CDC, ETL, replication)
  • Familiarity with data consistency challenges between OLTP and OLAP systems



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Debezium or CDC systems — understanding how schema changes affect downstream pipelines
  • Healthcare data or regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC2)
  • Data quality frameworks — validation, reconciliation, anomaly detection
  • dbt, Airflow, or similar transformation/orchestration tools
  • Performance benchmarking and capacity planning for OLAP databases
  • Experience with AWS RDS/Aurora operational features — Parameter Groups, Performance Insights.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

5- Suportar as etapas de design, implementação, teste, qualificação e validação de sistemas computadorizados e assegurar que todas as etapas sejam documentadas e aprovadas conforme os padrões internos e regulatórios.

6- Participar de investigações e análises de impacto relacionadas a mudanças nos sistemas computadorizados, identificando riscos à integridade de dados e propondo ações corretivas.

7- Participar de investigações de desvios relacionados aos sistemas, garantindo que as ações corretivas e preventivas (CAPAs) sejam executadas e documentadas adequadamente.

8- Fornecer suporte técnico durante auditorias internas e externas, bem como inspeções de órgãos regulatórios (ANVISA, FDA, EMA), respondendo a questionamentos sobre a validação dos sistemas computadorizados.

9- Garantir que os sistemas estejam preparados para auditorias, com a documentação de validação e rastreabilidade de dados completa e acessível.

10- Colaborar com as áreas de TI, automação, qualidade e produção para assegurar que os sistemas atendam às necessidades dos processos farmacêuticos e de controle de qualidade.

11- Fornecer orientação técnica e treinamentos sobre os procedimentos de validação e conformidade regulatória para outras equipes.

12- Implementar e validar sistemas que garantam a integridade de dados (Data Integrity), assegurando conformidade com os princípios ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate, Completeness, Consistent, Enduring, Available).

13- Monitorar o uso dos sistemas, identificando e corrigindo qualquer falha ou vulnerabilidade que possa comprometer a integridade de dados críticos.

title: Director of Marketing | Hotel Technology Experience Required
description:
We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next-generation, AI-native platform for the hospitality industry. Looking for a Director of Marketing who understands hotels, understands technology, and knows how to turn that knowledge into real growth.


This role is ideal for someone who has marketed to hotel decision-makers before and enjoys building campaigns, writing compelling content, and generating measurable demand.


About the Role

We’re building something special for the hotel industry, and we’re looking for a Director of Marketing who feels at home in the world of hotel technology.


If you’ve spent meaningful time marketing to hoteliers, understand how hotel decision-makers think, and enjoy rolling up your sleeves to create campaigns that drive pipeline, you’ll thrive in this role.


This is a hands-on, full-funnel leadership role responsible for building and scaling our marketing engine. You will oversee demand generation, product marketing, content creation, and go-to-market strategy while working closely with Sales to drive qualified leads and revenue growth.


The hospitality industry values clarity, trust, and solutions that make operations easier. We’re looking for someone who knows how to communicate exactly that.


What You’ll Be Doing

Develop a deep understanding of the hotel ecosystem, including independent hotels, management companies, and brand-affiliated properties.


Stay closely connected to the needs and priorities of hotel decision-makers such as:

  • General Managers
  • Directors of Sales and Marketing
  • Revenue Managers
  • Digital marketing leaders
  • IT leaders


Use these insights to shape messaging, positioning, and campaigns that resonate with hotel operators.


Owning the Marketing Engine

Build and manage the full marketing funnel—from awareness through lead generation, nurturing, and conversion to sales.


Key areas include:

  • Demand generation strategy
  • SEO and digital acquisition
  • Email and lifecycle marketing
  • Webinars and industry events
  • Campaign development and execution


Your goal is to ensure marketing consistently generates qualified pipeline for the sales team.


Leading Blog and Thought Leadership Strategy

Own and grow the company’s blog and thought leadership presence to establish authority in the hospitality technology space and drive inbound demand.


This includes:

  • Writing and overseeing blog content focused on hotel industry trends and insights
  • Creating thought leadership around topics like AI in hospitality, guest engagement, and direct booking strategies
  • Developing SEO-driven blog content that attracts hotel decision-makers researching solutions
  • Implement AI Engine Optimization (AEO) strategies to ensure the company and its content are discoverable through AI agents like Copilot, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other emerging AI-driven discovery platforms.
  • Repurposing blog content into campaigns, LinkedIn posts, webinars, and sales materials


Creating Content That Speaks the Hotel Industry’s Language

Develop and oversee content that resonates with hospitality leaders, including:

  • Blog articles and thought leadership pieces
  • Industry guides and educational resources
  • Case studies and ROI stories
  • Campaign messaging and landing pages
  • Sales enablement materials


The goal is content that feels authentic, practical, and directly relevant to hotel operators , while positioning the company as a trusted voice in hospitality technology.


Becoming Deeply Fluent in the Product

You will develop strong product knowledge and become fluent in how the platform works.


This includes understanding:

  • How the product integrates into the hotel technology stack
  • The operational problems it solves for hotel teams
  • The value it creates for revenue growth and guest engagement


This fluency will help shape messaging, positioning, and product launches.


Partnering Closely with Sales

Marketing and sales alignment is critical in this role.


You will work closely with the sales team to:

  • Align on pipeline and growth targets
  • Develop campaigns that generate qualified opportunities
  • Support sales with content, messaging, and materials
  • Continuously improve lead quality and funnel performance


Using Data to Drive Decisions

Track performance across the funnel and continuously improve marketing efficiency.


You will analyze:

  • Lead generation performance
  • Campaign ROI
  • Funnel conversion metrics
  • Customer acquisition trends


Marketing should be measurable, predictable, and scalable.


Success in This Role

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to build a scalable marketing engine that consistently generates qualified pipeline.


Key outcomes include:

  • Growth in marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline
  • Consistent generation of qualified leads for the sales team
  • Increased inbound demand through SEO, blog content, and thought leadership
  • Strong campaign performance across webinars, events, and digital channels
  • Clear and compelling positioning that resonates with hotel decision-makers


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience marketing to hotels or within the hospitality technology ecosystem
  • Experience in B2B SaaS marketing and demand generation
  • Proven ability to generate qualified pipeline and measurable revenue impact
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, including blogs and thought leadership content
  • Ability to translate complex technology into clear, compelling messaging
  • Comfort operating both strategically and hands-on
  • Experience collaborating closely with sales teams in a pipeline-driven environment
  • Interest in AI-driven platforms, automation, and emerging technology transforming hospitality


Experience at or working with hospitality technology platforms such as hotel CRM, guest engagement, marketing automation, revenue management, or hotel operations platforms is highly valued.


Why You Might Love This Role

You enjoy understanding how an industry works and building marketing that speaks directly to it.


You like owning the entire marketing engine , not just one channel.


You enjoy turning insight, content, and campaigns into measurable growth.


You want to help shape how the hospitality industry adopts the next generation of technology.


Why Join Us

You’ll be joining a modern AI-native product company that is helping reshape how hotels understand their guests, grow direct bookings, and operate more intelligently.


This is a rare opportunity to help introduce AI-powered guest engagement and marketing technology to the hospitality industry while building a marketing engine that drives real growth.


Your work will directly influence:

  • How the industry understands our product
  • How we position ourselves in the market
  • How we generate scalable demand


You won’t just run campaigns—you’ll help define how a new category of hospitality technology is introduced to the market and adopted by hotel leaders around the world.


If you’re energized by hospitality, great products, and building a marketing engine that truly moves the needle, we’d love to meet you.

title: Oracle EBS O2C Functional Consultant
description:
Job Title: Oracle EBS O2C Functional Consultant

Location: Brazil Remote

Duration: Nearshore / Contract


Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced Oracle EBS O2C (Order to Cash) Functional Consultant with strong expertise in Oracle E-Business Suite Financials and Order Management modules. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in end-to-end O2C cycle implementation and support, with added knowledge of Brazil tax regulations and localization requirements.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement, configure, and support Oracle EBS O2C modules including Order Management (OM), Accounts Receivable (AR), Advanced Pricing, and Inventory.
  • Manage end-to-end O2C cycle: Order Entry → Shipping → Invoicing → Receivables → Collections → Cash Application.
  • Gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into functional specifications.
  • Work closely with technical teams for RICEFW objects (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Extensions, Forms, Workflows).
  • Support month-end and year-end financial closing activities related to AR and revenue recognition.
  • Provide production support and resolve functional issues.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Finance, Supply Chain, and Tax.


Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience as an Oracle EBS Functional Consultant.
  • Strong hands-on experience in O2C modules (OM, AR, Pricing, Shipping, Inventory) .
  • Experience in at least one full lifecycle implementation.
  • Good understanding of accounting principles and AR processes.
  • Experience in writing functional design documents (FDDs).
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Brazil tax localization , including knowledge of Brazil tax laws (ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS).
  • Familiarity with Brazil fiscal reporting, Nota Fiscal (NF-e), and local statutory compliance requirements.
  • Experience working with global or LATAM implementations.

We’re a fast-paced, growing startup led by former Uber and Amazon team members, and we’re looking for someone excited to move quickly and contribute ideas that make a real impact.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and results-driven Marketing Specialist to join our team. This role combines strong execution skills with analytical thinking and excellent project management.


This role supports the planning and execution of marketing initiatives across multiple channels including email, SMS, social media, and website content. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working with data, and able to manage multiple marketing projects simultaneously.


You will work closely with other company departments to execute campaigns, analyze performance, and continuously improve how customers discover and engage with our products.

Marketing Strategy & Campaign Execution

  • Assist in the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across email, SMS, social media, website content, and seasonal promotions.
  • Coordinate campaign timelines and marketing calendars to support product launches, seasonal initiatives, and brand campaigns.
  • Support lifecycle marketing initiatives including newsletters, SMS campaigns, product launches, and promotional moments.
  • Collaborate with the team to identify marketing opportunities and propose ideas that improve campaign performance.



Content & Brand Communication

  • Write clear, engaging copy for newsletters, SMS campaigns, social media, blog posts, and other marketing materials.
  • Maintain a consistent brand voice across all marketing channels.
  • Coordinate content calendars aligned with seasonal themes, product launches, and marketing priorities.
  • Monitor social media conversations and user-generated content to identify engagement opportunities.


Digital Marketing & Analytics

  • Track and analyze campaign performance across email, SMS, social media, and website channels.
  • Interpret marketing data and provide actionable insights to improve campaign performance.
  • Assist with SEO initiatives including keyword research, content optimization, and website improvements.
  • Support customer surveys and feedback analysis to help inform product and marketing decisions.


Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Manage multiple marketing projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Work with designers, photographers, videographers, and other cross-functional partners to prepare creative briefs and campaign assets.
  • Ensure marketing initiatives are delivered on time and aligned with campaign goals.
  • Maintain a high level of organization and attention to detail across all marketing initiatives.


Requirements

  • Fluent in English (C1 level or higher). Exceptional written and spoken communication is essential.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in marketing, digital marketing, or content marketing.

  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Experience working with email and SMS marketing platforms such as Mailchimp, Attentive, or similar tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive mindset with the ability to suggest ideas and take initiative.
  • Strong copywriting skills with a knack for storytelling and brand voice.
  • Experience managing social media accounts and understanding platform best practices.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing principles, including email marketing and social content strategy.
  • Knowledge of SEO is a plus.


How to Apply

Candidates must submit their resumes in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.


Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment

The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:

  • Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.
  • Process Orientation: Showing your work and thinking ahead.
  • Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.
  • Taking Responsibility: Owning your actions.
  • Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.
  • Continuous Improvement: Always seeking better ways to work.
  • Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.
  • Believing in Meritocracy: Recognizing and rewarding performance.
  • Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.

title: Analista de CRM Pleno
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Buscamos Analista Pleno de CRM para atuar de forma estratégica e hands-on no planejamento, execução e evolução das ações de CRM da companhia. Essa pessoa será responsável por programar campanhas matriciais pontuais e réguas de ciclo de vida com foco na geração de valor a partir do Programa de Benefícios dos Shoppings ALLOS.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Planejar, programar e executar campanhas matriciais de CRM visando educar, fidelizar e engajar a base de clientes.
  • Propor hipóteses e realizar testes de forma contínua com o objetivo de gerar boas práticas e otimizar a atuação do CRM na companhia.
  • Monitorar a performance das ações implementadas, acompanhando seus KPIs, tanto operacionais quanto de negócio, e propondo otimizações.
  • Desenvolver relatórios para o acompanhamento de resultados, traduzindo dados em insights para apoiar os Shoppings, nossos principais stakeholders.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Ensino Superior Completo.
  • Experiência anterior na área de CRM;
  • Vivência em programação de campanhas usando plataforma de disparos de E-Mail, SMS e Push;
  • Aptidão para interpretar dados, realizar análises no dia a dia e trazer insights;
  • Experiência prévia com Programas de Benefícios será considerado um diferencial.

description:

Art of Spin is an ambitious iGaming startup within the Altenar ecosystem. We are building the brand from scratch and planning an aggressive international expansion with a portfolio of innovative slot games and unique mechanics.

Our goal is to become a recognized industry player by leveraging creativity and virality — succeeding where competitors rely primarily on massive marketing budgets.


Your Mission

To take the Art of Spin brand from “unknown” to a top-of-mind choice for operators and players, starting with the LATAM market and expanding into Asia and the United States.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Building the brand foundation: Development and implementation of the brand book and corporate website. The website must include a functional Client Hub with technical specifications (RTP, volatility) and marketing assets for partners.
  • Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy: Development and execution of launch plans for specific regions (especially Brazil and Mexico), including localization of game content to align with cultural specifics of the markets.
  • B2B promotion and networking: Active LinkedIn development: lead generation, publishing news about signed contracts and game launches. Working with aggregators and direct outreach to operators. Preparation for participation in key exhibitions (ICE, SiGMA).

Building and managing a network of streamers (from micro-influencers to major stars) and affiliates. Managing social media campaigns (TikTok, Instagram Reels) to showcase gameplay and big wins.

Candidate Requirements:


  • Deep expertise in iGaming: Minimum 5–10 years of experience in the industry; strong understanding of the entire ecosystem (provider — aggregator — operator — affiliate — player).
  • Knowledge of the LATAM market: Understanding of regional specifics, popular mechanics, traffic costs, and player preferences in Latin America (proven case studies in this region will be considered a strong advantage).
  • Startup mindset: Willingness to work within limited budgets, focusing on efficient organic growth strategies instead of expensive traditional campaigns.
  • Hands-on approach: At the initial stage, readiness to independently lead key processes (strategy, networking, creative briefs), with gradual team building of 3 specialists (SMM, commercial, design).
  • Creative drive: Ability not just to follow a plan, but to actively push the market and the team forward with bold ideas.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to build an international brand from scratch within a dynamic startup environment.
  • Work in a distributed international team (Cyprus, Malta).
  • High flexibility in decision-making.
  • Minimal corporate bureaucracy.
  • Real ownership and impact from day one.
